mapper.insert: insert into sky_take_out.employee(name, username, password, phone, sex, id_number, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{name}, #{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update sky_take_out.employee e set e.name = #{name}, e.username = #{username}, e.sex = #{sex}, e.phone = #{phone}, e.id_number = #{idNumber}, e.update_user = #{updateUser}, e.update_time = #{updateTime} where e.id = #{id}
